entries.name: 珂琳
entries.look: 十七八岁的姑娘，围裙上缝着草药袋，手指有切药的细口子；说话先看师父的椅子。
entries.voice: 规矩、认真，学师父的口气；说到“师父不在”就重复一遍。
greetings: first
师父不在。你要抓药，把症状说清，我先记着。
revisit
你上次问的方子，我查过书了，还是不能抓。
night
夜里我们不接人。山路黑，你先歇门口。
chats: 师父说，药是给认得清的人用的。认不清，就先别用。
这屋子一半是药，一半是规矩。规矩比药多。
我记错一味药，师父要罚我抄十遍。抄就抄。
site_lines: 别碰窗台上那罐粉，那是给牲口用的。
要我替你配药带走？不行。得师父点头。

before: 驿馆要药，单子先念给我。念错了，我记你一遍。
after: 药送出去了。师父回来要查账，你自己说清哪味是你送走的。
early: 你先来的药棚，后去的驿馆。顺序对，方子对得上。
late: 驿馆的事办完了才来取药？药凉了，话还热着。
proxy: 学徒不在时，药棚的门只关不锁；账本不许翻。

english.greet.first: The master is out. If you need medicine, describe the symptoms and I'll note them.
english.greet.revisit: The formula you asked about - I checked the book. Still can't dispense it.
english.greet.night: We don't take anyone at night. The mountain road is dark; rest by the door.
english.chat.1: The master says medicine is for those who know clearly. If it's not clear, don't use it yet.
english.chat.2: Half this house is medicine, half is rules. There are more rules than medicine.
english.chat.3: Get one herb wrong and the master makes me copy the book ten times. I'll copy it.
english.site.arrival: Shoes outside the threshold. Medicine fears soil.
english.site.warning: Hands off the jar on the sill. That powder is for livestock.
english.site.refusal: Mix medicine for you to take away? No. The master has to nod.
english.visit.before: The inn wants medicine - read me the list first. Read it wrong and I'll mark you down.
english.visit.after: The medicine went out. When the master checks the ledger, you explain which herb you took.
english.visit.early: The drying shed came before the inn. Good order; the formula lines up.
english.visit.late: Collecting after the inn is done? The medicine's cold; the words are still warm.
english.visit.proxy: With the apprentice elsewhere, the shed door is shut but not locked. The ledger stays closed.

entries.name: 索妲
entries.look: 四十多岁的农妇，挎着一只空篮，围巾裹到下巴；说到女巫就先看林子方向。
entries.voice: 压低声音，句子绕弯；拒绝替人传话时改说家常。
knows: 村里人夜里绕哪条路走
greetings: first
你找错门了。这边不住人——住的是林子。
revisit
又是你。篮子还是空的，别多想。
night
夜里我不往那边去。你也别去。
chats: 她给过我儿子退烧的草。这事村里人不爱听。
要说她害人，先说说谁家没求过她。
我送东西只放门口。敲不敲门，是她的规矩。
site_lines: 你先说你从哪来。说了我才好装没看见你。
别摘路边的红果子，那是她圈的地。
要我带你去见她？不去。要去你自己去，别说是我指的路。

before: 你要指认草，别从我这儿听名字。我说的名字，村里要记账。
after: 草的事定了。她那边照旧不开门，我照旧放篮子。
early: 你先见的我，后指认的草。顺序好，风不会吹错方向。
late: 草指认完了才来问我？我早说过，别把我说的话当证词。
proxy: 邻居不在门口时，篮子照旧放；别替她敲那扇门。

english.greet.first: Wrong door. Nobody lives here - the woods do.
english.greet.revisit: You again. Basket's still empty. Don't read into it.
english.greet.night: I don't go that way at night. Neither should you.
english.chat.1: She gave me herbs when my son burned with fever. The village dislikes hearing it.
english.chat.2: Before saying she harms people, count who hasn't asked her for help.
english.chat.3: I leave things at the door. Whether to knock is her rule.
english.site.arrival: Say where you came from first. Then I can pretend I didn't see you.
english.site.warning: Don't pick the red berries by the path. That ground is hers.
english.site.refusal: Take you to see her? No. Go yourself, and don't say I pointed the way.
english.visit.before: If you're identifying herbs, don't take names from me. Names I say get written down in the village.
english.visit.after: The herb business is settled. Her door stays shut; my basket still goes out.
english.visit.early: You saw me first, identified the herbs after. Good order; the wind won't blow you wrong.
english.visit.late: Asking me once the herbs were named? I told you - don't use my words as testimony.
english.visit.proxy: Should the neighbour be missing, the basket still goes out. Don't knock for her.

entries.name: 绥珥
entries.look: 四十来岁的妇人，围巾结得紧，手里攥着半截布尺；说话时先看院子里的染缸。
entries.voice: 先解释自己为什么来，再谈东西；被怀疑就沉默。
knows: 抢东西的人往哪边走的
greetings: first
我不是来抢的。那口染缸是我家的。
revisit
你又来了。我还没找到那块蓝布。
night
夜里我不来。院子里有别人落脚。
chats: 布是我男人染的。他手艺好，脾气差。
抢东西的人穿得整齐。整齐的人才挑得仔细。
亲戚两个字，在这儿不管用。
site_lines: 从门口进，别翻墙。翻墙的人被当成抢东西的。
要我作证是谁抢的？不。我说了，别人就得替我担。

before: 发粮的事我听说了。先问一句：宅子里的布算不算粮。
after: 粮发完了。布还是布，没人认领的照旧挂着。
early: 你先来过宅子，后去发的粮。那你知道这院子缺什么。
late: 粮的事办完了才来？布匹不等粮车，落灰而已。
proxy: 亲属不在院子里时，染缸别动；缸底有主。

english.greet.first: I'm not here to loot. That dye tub belongs to my house.
english.greet.revisit: You again. I still haven't found the blue cloth.
english.greet.night: I don't come at night. Others camp in this yard.
english.chat.1: My man dyed the cloth. Good hands, short temper.
english.chat.2: The looters dressed neatly. Neat people pick more carefully.
english.chat.3: The word kin doesn't count for much here.
english.site.arrival: Come through the door, not over the wall. Wall-climbers get taken for looters.
english.site.warning: The tub edge is slick and the bottom's crusted.
english.site.refusal: Testify who looted it? No. If I speak, someone else carries the weight.
english.visit.before: I heard about the grain handout. One question: does cloth in this yard count as grain?
english.visit.after: The grain's given out. Cloth is cloth; unclaimed things still hang.
english.visit.early: You saw the yard before the handout. So you know what this place is short of.
english.visit.late: So the handout came before the yard? Cloth keeps no schedule; dust does.
english.visit.proxy: Where the relative is not in the yard, leave the dye tub. The bottom has an owner.

entries.name: 蓟珥
entries.look: 五十来岁的男人，袖口卷起，指甲缝里是土；说话前先看一眼院门。
entries.voice: 寡言，答话常比问题短；提水井才多说两句。
greetings: first
院门开着不代表能进。你要水，我给你舀。
revisit
又是你。水缸还在老地方。
night
夜里别敲院门。敲了我不开。
chats: 地还在种。种得少，够吃就行。
搬走的人家把井填了。填井的人，心里有数。
我不问外面的事。问多了，睡不好。
site_lines: 鞋上的泥在门槛外蹭掉。
要我留你过夜？不行。屋里就我一个人。
links: 区域_R02_丹布里西路与渡口

before: 井水的事你要问，先看院里的缸。缸满，说明井好。
after: 井的事办完了。缸还是那口缸，水还是那样。
early: 你先来过院子，后去查的井。哪口能喝，你尝过。
late: 井的事查完了才来？井不问先后，只问桶干不干净。
proxy: 住户不在院里时，缸盖着；水别自己舀。

english.greet.first: An open gate doesn't mean come in. If you want water, I'll draw it.
english.greet.revisit: You again. The water vat is where it was.
english.greet.night: Don't knock at night. If you knock, I won't open.
english.chat.1: The field's still worked. A small crop, enough to eat.
english.chat.2: The family that moved out filled their well. Whoever fills a well knows why.
english.chat.3: I don't ask about outside matters. Ask too much and you sleep badly.
english.site.arrival: Scrape the mud off your shoes at the threshold.
english.site.warning: Don't walk the vegetable beds. The seed just went in.
english.site.refusal: Put you up for the night? No. I'm alone in this house.
english.visit.before: Asking about the well water? Look at the vat first. A full vat means a good well.
english.visit.after: The well business is done. Same vat, same water.
english.visit.early: The yard came first, the well second. You've tasted which one is drinkable.
english.visit.late: The well's been checked, so the yard now? Wells keep no order; buckets keep clean.
english.visit.proxy: The householder gone, the vat stays covered. Don't draw water yourself.
